recognize_zh: 這張 Cyclin D1 染色中，成片的中型腫瘤細胞核幾乎全為藍色陰性，只有零星散在的細胞（內皮細胞或組織球等內在對照）呈棕色陽性；表示此腫瘤 Cyclin D1 陰性，需以 SOX11 或 CCND2 重組支持被套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Sheets of medium-sized tumor cells with round to irregular nuclei, negative for nuclear cyclin D1
Only rare scattered cells show brown staining, serving as internal positive controls
Some positive signals are cytoplasmic/granular, compatible with histiocytes or endothelial cells
Finely dispersed chromatin on hematoxylin counterstain, compatible with blastoid morphology
describe_en: Immunohistochemistry for cyclin D1 shows that the diffuse population of medium-sized tumor cells lacks nuclear staining, while rare scattered non-neoplastic cells are positive, indicating adequate staining. The image therefore does not demonstrate the cyclin D1 overexpression expected in most mantle cell lymphomas. A cyclin D1-negative mantle cell lymphoma is still possible and would be supported by SOX11 positivity (as in the companion image) and CCND2 rearrangement; otherwise alternative blastoid B-cell neoplasms should be excluded.

ddx.vs: This variant is SOX11-positive and often carries CCND2 rearrangement despite lacking cyclin D1 protein.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma / high-grade B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These are SOX11-negative and may show MYC/BCL2 rearrangements, whereas MCL is SOX11-positive.
B-ALL is TdT-positive and may express SOX11, so TdT and surface immunoglobulin separate it from MCL.
